title: HuntTask
description: A narrowly-scoped vulnerability hunt assignment: ONE attack class against a specific code region.

attack_class.description: One concrete vulnerability class. Examples: sql_injection, command_injection, path_traversal, ssrf, xxe, deserialization, prototype_pollution, race_condition, integer_overflow, use_after_free, auth_bypass, idor, ssti, open_redirect, xss_stored, xss_reflected, regex_dos, zip_slip, log_injection.

scope_hint.description: Concrete locus to focus on. Include the trust boundary above the sink, e.g. 'HTTP handler in routes/users.py reads name from request.GET, passed unchanged to subprocess.Popen in services/exporter.py'.

target_files.description: Repo-relative file paths the hunter should focus on.

source.description: Which stage produced this task. 'reconcile' = F1 completeness re-queue; 'taint' = deterministic entry→sink chunking (V8); 'sink_backward' = orphan-sink backward audit — a dangerous sink no enumerated input reaches, hunted backward through its callers (F3); 'entry_forward' = one task per enumerated entry point followed forward, queued whether or not a sink was found behind it (W4.3) — sink-backward finds what is reachable FROM a known sink, entry-forward finds sinks the table does not know; 'specialist' = gated repo-wide specialist sweep (V12) — see 'specialist'; 'catchall' = terminal whole-repo coverage sweep (F6) — LOW-priority hunt for an eligible source file no other task covered.

specialist.description: Set when source='specialist': the SPECIALIST_HINTS key (audit.lang.hints) naming which repo-wide lens to hunt with — crypto|logic-bug|access-control|deserialization|batch-etl|iac|codegen. Flows into Hunt's hints_for(specialist=...) call so the researcher gets the specialist lens instead of the generic language hints.
